> 第 1655章 墓园（第1页）
艾罗·塔伦脸上并无紧张之色，甚至他的脸上还有嘲弄。
“那位至高的初王，现在也只能用这样的手段来恶心一下圣皇陛下了。”
眼见众人闻言好奇，艾罗·塔伦笑道。
“你们可能不太清楚。曾经的无尽浊世，初王是浊王们的无冕之王，实力远超一般的浊王，境界更在浊王之上。”
“只不过，圣皇陛下到来后，与诸王征战，强势斩杀他们中的八位王，并以无上伟力，斩去了这位无上王者的头颅，镇压在太初空的白金之月内。”
“而我繁星文明的生命女皇尤伦娜陛下，也化为月生之树，扎根白金之月，将这位初王的一切牢牢封锁。”
“所以，他如今做的这一切，都是无用功。”
艾罗·塔伦的发言，让一众仙庭诸军感到十分解气。
众军纷纷叫好，尤其是诺薇达莉和一众白空天使，更是脸上浮现骄傲。
“哼，什么初王，在圣皇陛下面前，还是太嫩了。”
当初，他差一点就沦落为和瞳皇的状态，便是这位初王的谋划。
要不是圣皇也有手段，隔空博弈，他或许就来不到这里了。
“圣皇之伟大，值得所有人敬仰。”
见到长衡仙帝的语气里，也是对姜尤的赞美。
那轮高悬于太初空的白金月亮，已经和其上的月生之树一般，所有繁星文明之人的信仰。
因为他们知道，如今是谁在庇佑他们。
“在山顶之上，便是你们真正应该抵达的地方了。“
但随着他们慢慢走近，那无言的孤寂、悲凉、惨烈、不屈的气势，开始缓缓笼罩在他们的心头。

随着第一块墓碑露出全貌，所有人都惊呆了。
只见这神山之顶，哪有什么诸多文明，只有一片一望无际的墓碑群。
无穷无尽的墓碑，矗立在荒凉的大地上，为这方天地，画下了悲壮的色彩。
“这…这…..这是由坟墓组成的海洋吗？”
“我感受到了来自于万古之前的悲烈之气，这是墓碑下埋葬的存在散发出来的吗？”
“从这里开始，一直到神山之巅，尽是无尽与浊世血战而牺牲的各大文明的英灵们的坟墓。”
“而在我们面前的是我繁星文明战死的英雄们的墓碑，他们埋葬在这里。”
“再往后，有一片比繁星文明的墓园更大的墓园，那是佛文明的英灵们埋葬的地方。”
“而更往后，还有一片更大的墓园。”

> Chapter 1655 Cemetery (Page 1)
There was no nervousness on Aero Talon's face, and there was even mockery on his face.
"The supreme first king can only use this method to disgust His Majesty the Holy Emperor."
Seeing that everyone was curious after hearing this, Aero Talon smiled.
"You may not know it well. In the endless troubled times, the First King was the uncrowned king of the kings. His strength far exceeded that of the ordinary kings, and his realm was even higher than that of the kings."
"It's just that after His Majesty the Holy Emperor arrived, he fought with the kings and killed eight of them with great force. With his supreme power, he beheaded the supreme king and suppressed it in the platinum moon of Taichu Sky."
"And Her Majesty Yulena, the Queen of Life of our Starry Civilization, also turned into a moon-born tree, taking root in the platinum moon, firmly sealing everything about this first king."
"So, everything he is doing now is in vain."
Aero Talon's speech made all the soldiers in the Immortal Court feel very relieved.
All the troops applauded, especially Novidali and the White Sky Angels, with pride on their faces.
"Hmph, you are the first king, you are still too young in front of His Majesty the Holy Emperor."
In the beginning, he almost fell into the state of He Tonghuang, which was the plan of the first king.
If the Holy Emperor hadn't also had the means to play games in the air, he might not have come here.
"The Holy Emperor is great and deserves everyone's respect."
The tone of Immortal Emperor Changheng's expression when he saw him was also praising Jiang You.
The platinum moon hanging high in the early sky has become the same as the moon-growing tree above it, and is the belief of all starry civilizations.
Because they know who is protecting them now.
"On the top of the mountain is where you should really arrive."
But as they slowly approached, the silent loneliness, sadness, cruelty, and unyielding momentum began to slowly envelope their hearts.
As the first tombstone was revealed, everyone was stunned.
On the top of this sacred mountain, there is no civilization, only an endless group of tombstones.
Endless tombstones stand on the desolate land, painting a tragic and solemn color for this world.
"Is this...this...is this a sea of graves?"
"I feel the sadness that came from eternity ago. Is this coming from the existence buried under the tombstone?"
"From here, all the way to the top of the sacred mountain, are the graves of the heroic spirits of all major civilizations who died in endless bloody battles against the troubled times."
"And in front of us are the tombstones of the heroes of our starry civilization who died in battle. They are buried here."
"Further back, there is a cemetery larger than the cemetery of the Starry Civilization. That is where the heroic spirits of the Buddhist civilization are buried."
"And further back, there is a larger cemetery."
